name: Arrival at Warner
description: ACCEPTANCE SCENE, not final canon. Exercises the whole step vocabulary end to end: background, music, two characters entering, a reaction between lines, an exit and a clean ending. The writing is placeholder.

steps.speaker: commander
steps.text: Convoy stopped a klick back. Whatever came through here, it came through fast.

steps.speaker: reyes
steps.text: I pulled the district file on the way in. Warner was evacuated eleven days ago. Signed off, stamped, filed.

steps.speaker: commander
steps.text: Then the report says Warner was evacuated.

steps.speaker: reyes
steps.text: Vale... no it doesn't. It says the evacuation was *authorised*. Nobody ever filed the part where anyone left.

steps.speaker: commander
steps.text: Then there are still people down there. Get Kell on the ridge and tell him to keep his hands off the trigger until I say so.

steps.speaker: reyes
steps.text: Telling Kell not to shoot. My favourite part of the job.

steps.speaker: commander
steps.text: Eleven days. And not one of them thought to check.
